title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10983)
clause_1_scope: This standard gives the dimensions and associated tolerances of housings for hydraulic and pneumatic seals for reciprocating applications. The range of sizes covered in this standard is 16 to 500 nun for cylinders and 6 to 360 mm for rods.

dimensional_tolerances: tolerance on housing length shall be + 0*25 mm
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
